lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately 10-12 visible vertical columns with roughly equidistant horizontal spacing between centroids.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are aligned with the vertical columns of spots, creating a lattice pattern where the highest-intensity blobs reside at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the most prominent is located in the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance upper edge to shadowed lower margin, running parallel to the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin and along the lower lateral flank.
